source_docs.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for AI: A Survey
source_docs.text:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: A Survey. Authors: Yunfan Gao, Yun Xiong, Xinyu Gao, Kangxiang Jia, Jinliu Pan. Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation merges retrieval with generative models to overcome hallucinations. arXiv URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.10997. Published Date: 2024-01-15.

Modular RAG: Advanced Paradigms and Architectural Evolution. Authors: Terry Yue Zhuo, Yiran Wang, Patrick Lewis. Abstract: Formalizing the evolution of RAG pipelines into modular architectures. arXiv URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.05131. Published Date: 2024-02-08.
